QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_45

question.text: Chapter 2 references the Indian philanthropy market (as an opportunity that DIBs can help build trust in). The size of this market is estimated at approximately:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.68, the Indian philanthropy market is estimated at over INR 35,000 crore. The text frames this as an opportunity that DIBs can help build trust in. The Trap: Option B (INR 3,500 crore) is 10x too low. Option C (INR 3,50,000 crore) is 10x too high. Option D (INR 350 crore) is 100x too low. Note: The INR 35,000 crore figure contextualises the scale of the philanthropy market that the SSE framework aims to channel toward measurable social impact.
